title: PVP kits
description: This data pack adds functions to the game, giving you PvP kits with tiers.
body:
PvP Kits

  A simple Minecraft Java datapack that adds 5 ready-to-use PvP kit tiers for servers, arenas, and minigames.

  Use /function pvp:tier1 through /function pvp:tier5 to instantly give yourself a PvP loadout. Each tier increases in strength, starting with basic leather gear and
  scaling up to legendary netherite equipment.

  Features

  - 5 PvP kit tiers
  - Works with the player running the function
  - Armor, weapons, food, potions, bows, crossbows, shields, pearls, wind charges, and more
  - Includes newer combat items like spears, mace, and trident
  - Uses vanilla-safe enchantment levels
  - No custom items or resource pack required

  Commands

  /function pvp:tier1
  /function pvp:tier2
  /function pvp:tier3
  /function pvp:tier4
  /function pvp:tier5

  Installation

  1. Download the datapack.
  2. Put it in your world’s datapacks folder.
  3. Run:

  /reload

  4. Test with:

  /function pvp:tier1
